BiblicalUsage: Aspatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, named once in the list of the men the Jews slew in Shushan, whose bodies were hanged on the gallows their father had built for Mordecai.
TheologicalSignificance: The verse records judgment on a house that plotted murder, and I will not soften it. The gallows Haman raised for another became the end of his own sons — the Bible's own warning that the pit a man digs is the pit he falls into.
